notes: • Privacy: your API keys and passwords now live in the macOS keychain (moved automatically on first launch). New Settings ▸ Privacy shows exactly what leaves this Mac, blocks cloud AI with one switch, clears the diagnostic log and erases a matter completely — including an external storage folder and the Word exhibit list. A one-time notice names the provider and region before the first cloud AI call. Bug and crash reports: attaching the log is now opt-in, user paths and addresses are masked, and “Show what will be sent” previews the report. Document names no longer appear in the diagnostic log.
